product_stage_readiness.label: Product-stage readiness
blockers: Hosted operations, restore proof, provider incident recovery, performance, and representative product-task evidence remain incomplete.

workspace_evidence_readiness.label: Per-workspace evidence readiness
blockers: This score is user-specific and must be sampled from a running workspace; it is not the product intelligence score.

dimensions.label: Representative source coverage
blockers: Gmail is the only live connector.
No manifest-attested live balance-provider cohort is available.

dimensions.label: Ledger correctness and lifecycle truth
blockers: Broad representative lifecycle, cross-account matching, and interval reconciliation evidence is incomplete.

dimensions.label: Account position and reconciliation
blockers: The >=10 user, >=100 interval, >=6 institution representative cohort has not passed.
No production balance provider or issuer adapter is connected.

dimensions.label: Temporal knowledge
blockers: Broader connector lineage and historical reconstruction evidence remain incomplete.

dimensions.label: Forecasting and uncertainty
blockers: The >=5 representative user, >=3 matured period calibration cohort has not passed.

dimensions.label: Decision quality
blockers: Representative usefulness, conflict optimization, and safe-refusal outcomes remain incomplete.

dimensions.label: Learning and personalization
blockers: Versioned per-user baselines, minimum samples, drift controls, and rollback proof are incomplete.

dimensions.label: Query and conversational reasoning
blockers: No reviewed grounded-query evaluation set or product-task success cohort has passed.

dimensions.label: Explainability and safety
blockers: Critical surfaces do not yet have complete source, cutoff, coverage, assumption, and recovery-path evaluation.

dimensions.label: Evaluation and operations
blockers: Strict representative evidence, hosted alerting, restore, incident, and performance gates have not all passed.

components.label: Integration hygiene
blockers: No two-sprint integration and migration-parity telemetry exists.

components.label: First-pass verification
blockers: First-pass CI success is not currently retained as sprint telemetry.

components.label: Lead time and WIP age
blockers: Selected-to-integrated lead time and active WIP age are not currently measured.

components.label: Evidence conversion
blockers: Completed score-bearing items are not yet joined to same-sprint evidence artifacts.

components.label: Operational completeness
blockers: Release-level migration, rollback, observability, performance, privacy, and owner evidence is not measured as one component.
